summary: First 8192 tokens of the self-attention of block 29 of a real Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B QAD stage-1 flow-matching training step at sigma 0.5, carrying q, k, v, the attention output o and the recorded attention-output gradient do in [1, S, 12, 128] bf16.

upstream.notes: The only executable dependency of the capture besides torch and diffusers. No fused attention package is installed: both stages route every attention call through torch SDPA.

prompt: A bustling city street at night, filled with the glow of car headlights and the ambient light of streetlights. The scene is a blur of motion, with cars speeding by and pedestrians navigating the crosswalks. The cityscape is a mix of towering buildings and illuminated signs, creating a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere. The perspective of the video is from a high angle, providing a bird's eye view of the street and its surroundings. The overall style of the video is dynamic and energetic, capturing the essence of urban life at night.
negative_prompt: WAN_CONFIGS['t2v-1.3B'].sample_neg_prompt of the pinned upstream commit

latent.role: x0, the clean latent the training step interpolates from
latent.method: flow-matching sample of the pinned model itself, in latent space; the decoder is never run
latent.attention: torch SDPA in bf16, non-causal, scale = 1/sqrt(D), for both the self-attention and the cross-attention path

training_step.recipe: FastVideo QAD stage-1 attention-QAT finetune, weighting scheme uniform with the draw replaced by a pinned sigma
training_step.loss: F.mse_loss(pred.float(), target.float())  [mean over all latent elements]
training_step.gradient_checkpointing: full, torch.utils.checkpoint with use_reentrant=False, on every transformer block

capture.hook: forward records q, k, v, o; a tensor hook on o records do = dL/do from the first, graph-carrying forward (non-reentrant checkpointing runs the block twice)
capture.tensor_layout: B,S,H,D contiguous; permute(0, 2, 1, 3) for the [B, H, S, D] kernel contract
capture.o_role: orientation material only; the golden reference recomputes its own attention output
capture.do_role: dL/do of a mean-reduced MSE loss, so its absolute scale is ~1e-8 and is a loss normalisation constant, not an operator property

sanity_bands.note: Measured on the H100 reference capture and widened by x/2 on the RMS and x/4 on the absolute maximum. The runtime enforces them on every load so a wrong capture fails closed even though the bytes differ across GPUs.

reference_capture.role: provenance only; no deployment is required to reproduce these bytes
